text:
Hi Cobalt Fintech hiring team,

Thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today about the Software Development Engineer I position. I really enjoyed learning more about the team and the exciting work you are doing at Cobalt Fintech.

Our conversation made me even more enthusiastic about this opportunity. During my internship at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, worked with PostgreSQL and Kafka, and participated in the on-call rotation. I am eager to bring this backend development experience to your team.

Thank you again for your time and consideration, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps.

Best regards,

Alex Rao
